column1: # Security headers Regen expects on every page.
# One check per line: header name, severity when it's missing, and why it matters. Tab-separated.
# To add a check, add a line. CI runs every line against a test server (tests/run.sh).

column3: Without HSTS, a first visit over plain HTTP can be downgraded or intercepted.
Without a CSP, any injected script runs with the page's full access.
Without nosniff, browsers may run uploaded or mislabeled files as scripts.
Without it, older browsers let other sites frame the page (clickjacking). CSP frame-ancestors covers current ones.
Without it, full URLs (and anything in them) leak to other sites in the Referer header.
Without it, the page and anything it embeds can ask for the camera, microphone or location.
Legacy browsers only; modern ones ignore it. Set to 0 or 1; mode=block.
